title: Understanding Correlation
text: A correlation of $$0$$ indicates that there is no linear relationship between the two variables. This means that changes in temperature do not predict changes in tip size.

title: Scatterplot Interpretation
text: If the correlation is $$0$$, the scatterplot of tip against temperature would not show any discernible pattern. The points would appear randomly scattered.

title: Linear Regression Coefficients
text: In a linear regression model, if the correlation between the independent and dependent variable is $$0$$, the slope of the line $$\theta_1$$ will be $$0$$.

title: Understanding $$\Theta_1$$
text: What will be the value of $$\theta_1$$ if the correlation is 0?

title: $$\Theta_0$$ in Regression
text: $$\Theta_0$$ represents the intercept of the regression line. It is not necessarily $$0$$ even if the correlation is $$0$$.
